The retrieval layer selects candidates by scope before it ranks them. A relevance
score is not an access right, and a cache key collision is not a permission. When
a query names a scope the principal may not read, the answer is that there is no
in-scope evidence, and the system says so rather than quietly widening the search
until it finds something. This paragraph is ordinary English prose and exists to
measure how many tokens a byte of ordinary English prose costs.
